texto:
Urban gardening is becoming very popular in big cities around the world. Many people live in apartments and do not have big yards like in the countryside. But they still want to connect with nature and grow their own food. Urban gardening is the solution. It means growing plants in small spaces within a city.

People are very creative with their urban gardens. They use balconies, windowsills, and even rooftops to plant vegetables, herbs, and flowers. You can see small tomato plants on a sunny balcony or fresh mint growing in a kitchen window. Some communities also create shared gardens in empty lots. This is a great way for neighbors to work together and share the food they grow.

The benefits are clear. Urban gardeners get to eat fresh, healthy food without pesticides. It is also a relaxing activity that reduces stress. Plus, it makes our cities greener and more beautiful.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, where do people create urban gardens?

opciones.A: Only in big yards in the countryside
opciones.B: In special parks outside the city

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C porque el texto enumera estos lugares específicos. En el segundo párrafo, dice claramente: 'They use balconies, windowsills, and even rooftops to plant vegetables, herbs, and flowers'. Las otras opciones son incorrectas. La A es lo opuesto a la idea del texto; B y E no se mencionan; y D es incorrecta porque el texto habla de 'small spaces' y no exclusivamente de granjas comunitarias.

preguntas.pregunta: What can be inferred about the people who practice urban gardening?

opciones.A: They sell all the vegetables they grow for money
opciones.B: They think city life is not beautiful
opciones.C: They find it to be a positive and rewarding activity
opciones.D: They are all professional gardeners with a lot of experience
opciones.E: They do not have jobs and have a lot of free time

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no lo dice explícitamente, pero podemos inferirlo de los beneficios descritos. Menciona que la gente quiere 'connect with nature', que es una 'relaxing activity that reduces stress', y que obtienen 'fresh, healthy food'. Todo esto sugiere que es una experiencia positiva y gratificante. The other options cannot be inferred. The text doesn't mention selling vegetables (A), it suggests gardening makes cities 'more beautiful' (contradicting B), and there is no information about gardeners being professionals (D) or unemployed (E).
